import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if len(data) < 3:
        return
    m1 = int(data[0])
    m2 = int(data[1])
    m3 = int(data[2])
    
    total = m1 + m2 + m3
    average = total // 3
    diff = max(m1, m2, m3) - min(m1, m2, m3)
    product = m1 * m2
    
    print(f"Total Marks: {total}")
    print(f"Average Marks: {average}")
    print(f"Difference: {diff}")
    print(f"Product: {product}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
